balls.text: that's the short ball, to trump the batsman rushing down the pitch. Gets a top edge that is pouched at long-off.
down the track amd smokes a length ball over long-on! Kisses a few raindrops on its way into the crowd. This ends up a length ball as Morgan races down the pitch and nails it
wnother pin-point yorker on middle, pushed to long-on where Kohli misfields because of the wetness around. He's yelling at the umpire, I think, about the rain and how it's impeding the fielding
down the track, but Starc fires the ball at the batsman's legs to cramp him. Warner can only push it into the covers for a single. Doesn't like that he's been pinned down like that
follows Morgan's move down the leg side, Morgan swipes it away to long leg.
yorker on middle at 145 kph, Morgan can't do anything about it. Jams his bat down and protects his stumps
down the track to push a good length ball to long-off
great work by yuzi! Dives to full-length to his left to hold a cut down at short third man. Warner had done well too, to wait for the ball and try and beat the man. Comes out second best though
fuller delivery outside off, dabbed into the covers for a single

and there is proof that Henriques' bat has an edge. Wiese gets it as he bowls the ball wide, trying to evade his reach. The slash over the covers doesn't come out as well as he'd hope, but this has been an innings of immense value for Sunrisers
moves outside leg, Wiese loops it outside off. Ends up a full toss. Warner reaches it and slaps it through the covers. That's his fifty too!
switches against the fast bowler, this time and he enjoys a fortunate outside edge. Wiese can only smile. Warner's smile is a little more joyous. That's the hundred partnership
hammered down the ground. This is even looooonger! Length ball, muscled into the delirious crowd over long-on
there's his fifty! Blitz of an innings, but yet he's played such sweet-looking shots. Nudges to deep square leg and snags a couple
tossed up outside leg, Warner lifts it to mid-off. That seems something like a knuckle-ball. Pushed through off the front of the hand
gets down the track, and slips in his eagerness. Thumped back at the bowler

switch cover drive! And there's a misfield. Better delivery from Chahal as he fires it in outside off, at the right-handed Warner. Kohli is a little ginger chasing the ball, because of the outfield being soggy perhaps
walllooped! Was that the switch hit? Yep! Temporarily becomes right handed and slog-sweeps a googly from Chahal over deep deep point, which becomes square leg
full on leg stump, Henriques stays very still, except for his wrists that power the ball to deep square leg
full on leg stump, squeezed to long-on
good length on leg stump, Warner's moved outside the line and eases it to deep point. AB's down there, but he isn't quick enough to deny the batsman a second run
moves outside leg and crease a fuller length delivery follows him. But he's angled the face and smears the full toss past cover
dropped! Sarfaraz is the culprit at point, coming right at him, doesn't even have to move. It was a fuller ball with some width. Henriques goes for a slash, but hasn't got the elevation he wants
shortish and outside off, slashed to the sweeper

chance! chance.... not converted! goes for the yorker, keeps Henriques quiet. Well, almost. the batsman wants a single. There is none on offer because the ball has barely moved away from the pitch. Harshal races up, picks up the ball, has ample time for the underarm throw. Henriques is well outside his ground.... but the throw misses. The simplest throw. Warner's guffawing. Kohli is livid. He could have run up and kicked the stumps off
that's unfortunate... that's really unfortunate. It's the slower ball, wonderfully disguised. Henriques goes for a slog over square leg. Outside edge skews away over third man

width on offer, viciously dealt with! It's in the slot again, very little pace on it. Henriques pulls out his fork and spoon and napkin and tucks in. Fastest fifty this season, anyone? Kohli and Harshal are in deep conversaion
slanted well outside off, Henriques knows he's got the umpire's favour on this and leaves
full toss on leg stump, clipped to deep midwicket and Warner has lugged himself for a second. Top running
this is brilliant batting! Opens the face and dabs this lovely slower ball, it's only mistake the width on offer, and collects a boundary past the keeper.
dropped by Madeep at long-off. Loves the length ball, opens up his arms but he hasn't timed it s as sweetly. Mandeep has to move to his left a bit, but besides that this was regulation
full on leg stump, nudged to long-on

he is in some form today! The way the ball is leaping off the middle of his bat is scary. Sitting deep in his crease, predicting the bowler going for a yorker. Ends up overpitched and it's hammered over long-off. Fllllllat six
length ball outside off, Henriques opens up his hips and belts the ball through. Mandeep's dive is not enough this time. And it's a no-ball as well. Time for a free hit
low full toss on leg stump, thumped down to long-on. So powerfully hit that it's only one. Great work from Mandeep too, diving away to his right
goes for a wide yorker, Warner looks to jam an angled bat down on it. Inside edge leaps away over the keeper
it's the offcutter and he's beaten Warner. His own fault for complicating matters by jumping away from the ball. In the end, he can't reach the good length ball angled across him
whipped off his legs to deep square leg, that's a full toss as well
down the track, heaves a full toss down the ground to long-off. And the ump calls it a no-ball for height... But shouldn't there be leeway for the batsman charging?

he's stopped it, no it's slipped away, no he's got to it... Ah, the ball finally beats AB. Its flatter and affords the batsman room. Henriques' power game is spot on tonight. Nails the drill through the covers
crrrrrunch! This is an absolute KO. Races down the pitch and pummels a flatter delivery straight down the ground. Soars into the crowd quite handsomely
tossed up outside leg, Warner nudges it to the left of where mid-on would have been. As such Yuzi has to chase after the ball himself
goes back and taps a good length ball to long-on
saw the batsman running away outside leg again and follows him. Hits the blockhole too, so only a single through the covers
starts off with a short one and Warner makes his own room and slashes it wide of long-off. Mandeep attempts to keep it in, doesn't have a chance
another near yorker, Warner was looking for a slice through the off side. has to accept an inside edge for a single to the keeper

140kph, great work from Dinda. They're going upstairs to check a run-out. But Warner is miles in. finds the yorker on leg stump and stymies Henriques. Inside edge dribbles away from his pads. Warner wants a single, Dinda races up as well. Makes a direct hit, but he's not quick enough
misses the spot and Warner doesn't manage enough of a connection. Clears the front leg and goes for a slash, ends up with an inside edge towards midwicket
looks for the yorker and lands it quite well. Henriques digs it out into the covers
shortish on middle, Warner camps back in his crease and heaves it to deep midwicket
140 kph, half-volley outside off, Henriques crunches it to the sweeper
a hint of width and Henriques looks to exploit it. Goes for a crack through the covers, but the four-man off-side ring can't be breached
picked up the slower ball early again, waits for it to reach him and cuts to deep point
wanders away outside leg and Wiese bends his back to beat him with a shortish delivery angled across
fuller delivery on off stump, but Warner puts that front leg aside and hits through the line. Didn't get all of it, but he's hit it straight enough to beat mid-off
shortish and angled in at the body, Wiese is distraught as he sees the ball slides past the batsman, who was trying a flick, and the keeper misses it. Doesn't need to be.

this is normal pace, this is short, and Dhawan has picked out mid-on. Wanted to smash it far longer as he rocked back for the pull, but his intention to hit the ball a bit too hard has hurt his timing. Comes off the bottom of the bat. Wry grin as he walks back, knew he should have belted that
introduces himself with a slower ball, Dhawan says I see you and clobbers it over wide long-on.. Backed himself to clear the field and did so easily
goes short and wide, Warner forehands it down to the long-off boundary. Had to get up on his toes and then he let his power do the talking
lifts the shortish delivery to long-off. Read the change of pace better this time as he held his shot a touch before unleashing it
119kph, another slower ball and it's away from Warner's reach outside off. Goes for a slog and misses
loads up a full toss, driven with the angled bat to deep point
chopped past point, but there is protection in the deep. Not much room on offer, but he's got it away pretty well.
pulls the pace off, good intuition as Dhawan hurries down the track and is beaten.
143kph, goes short and sliding down a touch. Dhawan swivels in the crease for a pull. But all he does is spoon the ball towards midwicket. Lucky there wasn't anyone around
146kph, shortish on middle and leg, Warner taps it down to mid-on
full and swinging down, Dhawan was looking for a flick. Doesn't connect. Leg bye as the ball deflects off the pad to square leg
140kph, back of a length and cramping him up, Warner rolls his wrists to find midwicket
looks for a yorker on middle stump, wobbles in at Warner as well who was looking to jam it into the covers. Inside edge past short fine leg
full on leg stump, nudged towards mid-on

RCB have won it! Warner has touched the rope while looking to tack a catch on the boundary! Kohli goes mad!  He's played an immensely awesome final over. This ball though wasn't the best, it was length and he got under it. Lifts it high into the air, Warner tracks it well and takes the catch. He's celebrating, but as he backpeddles doing so, he trods on the turf

this is sublime again! It was the bowler one-upping the batsman first, with a wide yorker as Kohli shaped for a lap sweep. But then he adjusts and slices it between point and third man. Such a clear mind, such terrific reactions
betters the yorker! He's standing so deep in his crease, he's preempting the yorker and imbues the strength of his forehand into the slide through point

walks at the bowler, has a full toss, thumps it back towards long-on, but DK's bat intervenes. The ball is deflected to Bhuvi, who completes an easy run out. Kohli is livid as Karthik, who had raced down the pitch looking for runs, just keeps on going to the dressing room
it's a low full toss outside off, DK is forward and crouches to lap the ball over to long leg. Could have been two, but the captain disagrees. He wants it
full on leg stump, whipped through the leg side for only a single
hits the yorker on middle, nudged to midwicket for a quick single
lobs up a length ball, a slower ball, and Kohli sets up on the back foot and pummels it over cow corner. Hit harder than some of Gayle's biffs
yorker on leg stump, squeezed out to deep square leg. PK is displeased that the fielder allows Kohli to get back. Gee, he's quick
saw the batsman running outside leg and flings down a widish yorker. But manages to stay inside the wide line. Great presence of mind
leg-stump full toss has been whipped to deep square leg! Silly cricket galore, and what can you expect in a six-over shoot out?
it works! Down the track to a flatter ball and thumped over long-on
down the track to swipe a good length ball to deep midwicket. Two again, and Kohli asks for a change of bat

Karn drops it! It's a skier, swirls in the air. Long-on and Deep midwicket were rushing in as well, but the bowler was the closest. But he is nervous underneath it. Had to run back, looking at the ball over his shoulder. Dives forward but the ball only grazes his finger tips
down the track and heaves the flat delivery down the ground. It's too quick for him though, it throws him off balance and it's got no timing. Warner at long-off keeps it to a single
down the track, but Karn flattens his trajectory. Slapped to long-on
flighted on leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket and Kohli hustles through for a couple. Big dive to beat the throw from the deep
another slower ball a shade outside off, Mandeep looks for a slash but he doesn't beat the field at cover. Only three runs given
on a hat-trick! But it's a short ball that's sliced to point

golden duck! It is Henriques' night and he will not be denied. Lobs up a slower ball, which brings out the AB golf swing. But he mistimes it, carries only as far as long-on. Steyn's the man, who is as pumped up as ever
nailed it to deep midwicket! Same ploy, whisking that front leg aside and smearing the short ball hard and flat. But he picks out the fielder, Dhawan, who takes a pressure catch
goes short, very short. Gayle stands up to his full height as he leaves. Passes him well over his head
back of a length on leg stump, slugged away to deep midwicket. The field can spread
play and miss, is that the first? This was a back of a length delivery seaming away from Kohli's down the track smash
hammered over wide long-off! Bhuvi hasn't been able to get those yorkers going. This is overpitched and Gayle has sliced it handsomely over the off side

full on leg stump, Gayle has managed to squeeze it past short fine leg. He goes for a flick, ends up with an inside edge that skirts through his splayed legs. With only two fielders outside, mis-hits are disappearing
this time it's in the slot, yorker gone wrong and Gayle has muscled it into the crowd well beyond long-on. Warner is stone-faced
there's the one he wants. The yorker a shade outside off, jammed back at the bowler amid great applause. That delivery deserved every bit of it
shortish, that sets Gayle up for the pull. Clears the front leg and heaves it away. Massive player, massive hit.

what is that?! How has he got that to third man?! He is cramped for room, he is looking for a tuck through square leg, he is beaten for the lack of pace. And the ball leaps off his top edge to third man boundary
low full toss on middle, whipped to midwicket on the edge of the circle

this is a length ball, Kohlie gets under it. Perhaps a bit too much. Henriques is the man coming across to his right from midwicket, but he doesnt' move forward. He needs to, because the ball dies on him

whip of the wrists! That's majestic! It was a good length ball a shade outside off, quite the perfect delivery in Test matches, here in this skewed version, it's been whipped over midwicket. Such balance!
144kph, shortish and slid down leg, pulled past short fine leg. Gayle wants two, stop the press! But Kohli denies it
short ball, dispatched! This one allowed Gayle room, and he'd made some for himself as well. Sat up for the pull and he's monstered it! Leaves a few in the crowed gaping...
slammed away to the square leg boundary! It's a shade shortish on leg stump, following Gayle's movement outside leg. But he is able to slug it away
